items.definition: the main building at an airport where passengers check in, wait and board their flights
items.example: Our taxi dropped us outside the airport terminal at six in the morning.
items.gapSentence: The taxi stopped outside the airport terminal, and we hurried in with our suitcases.

items.definition: the place where you leave your suitcase if you have already checked in and have your boarding pass
items.example: We had checked in online, so we went straight to the bag drop.
items.gapSentence: We had checked in online, so we went straight to the bag drop to leave our suitcases.

items.definition: the area where passengers collect their luggage after the plane has landed
items.example: We waited at baggage reclaim for forty minutes, but my suitcase never appeared.
items.gapSentence: After landing, we waited at baggage reclaim for forty minutes, but my suitcase never appeared.

items.definition: the counter where airline staff check your ticket and passport and give you a boarding pass
items.example: There was a long queue at the check-in desk, so we arrived early.
items.gapSentence: There was a long queue at the check-in desk because everyone needed a boarding pass.

items.definition: the place where officers check whether you are bringing in anything illegal or something you must pay tax on
items.example: She had nothing to declare, so she walked quickly through customs.
items.collocationSentence: Do you have anything to ___ at customs?
items.gapSentence: She had nothing to declare, so she walked quickly through customs.

items.definition: a large screen that shows flight times and whether each flight is on time, boarding, closed or delayed
items.example: I kept looking at the departures board to see whether our flight was delayed.
items.gapSentence: I kept looking at the departures board to see whether our flight was delayed.

items.definition: the exit in an airport terminal where you show your boarding pass and get on the plane
items.example: Gate 14 was at the far end of the terminal, so we had to run.
items.gapSentence: Our flight was boarding at gate 14, at the far end of the terminal.

items.definition: a long strip of hard ground where planes take off and land
items.example: The plane waited on the runway for twenty minutes before taking off.
items.gapSentence: The plane waited on the runway for twenty minutes before it finally took off.

items.definition: the place where officers check passengers and hand luggage for liquids, sharp objects and other banned items
items.example: At security, I had to take out my laptop and put my liquids in a plastic bag.
items.gapSentence: At security, I had to take out my laptop and put my liquids in a plastic bag.

items.definition: a comfortable waiting area at an airport for passengers who have a first-class or business-class ticket
items.example: We relaxed in the airline lounge with a coffee while we waited for our flight.
items.gapSentence: Business-class passengers can relax in the airline lounge before their flight.
